jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo eccelle nel trasformare la complessità in chiarezza? Sei eccitato plasmando idee, presupposti stimolanti e amplificando l’impatto di un leader?
• Stiamo cercando un New Builds Development & Delivery Manager che agirà come estensione del Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, migliorando il pensiero strategico, migliorando la velocità decisionale e aiutando a portare concetti robusti e di alta qualità alla leadership senior. Questo ruolo non è operativo e non è una posizione di presentazione. Si tratta di un ruolo di partnership, progettato per qualcuno che può pensare criticamente, strutturare problemi ambigui, sfidare intuizioni e sostenere lo sviluppo di concetti di esperienza degli ospiti trasformazionali. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate attraverso Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild e Strategy, assicurando che i concetti siano analiticamente sani, orientati agli insight e allineati alle aspettative dell'azienda. Potrai ottenere l'esposizione a discussioni strategiche, influenzare il processo decisionale senior, e guidare la chiarezza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di innovazione. Se sei un pensatore acuto, un sfidante naturale, e un partner affidabile in grado di elevare il lavoro degli altri, questo è il ruolo per voi Il tuo impatto Supporto strategico e partenariato di pensiero - Agire come partner strategico diretto al Senior Manager, aiutando il pensiero della struttura, i problemi della struttura e affinare le narrazioni dei concetti. - Partecipare o condurre riunioni selezionate per conto dell'Innovazione dell'esperienza ospite - Preparare brevi strategici, quadri decisionali e documenti di sintesi per conversazioni a livello SVP. Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Comunicazione - Materiali di storytelling chiari, concisi e strategicamente sani per forum di leadership - Trasformare informazioni complesse in narrazioni ad alto impatto. - Sostenere la leadership nella preparazione delle discussioni del Comitato SVP/EVP/Executive. Collaborazione trasversale - Coinvolgere con i team Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy e Operations per raccogliere idee e concetti di forma. - Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di nuovi concetti di intrattenimento, esperienze e spazi attraverso la nostra flotta. - Agire come il collegamento chiave tra partner creativi, operazioni e funzioni aziendali, garantendo allineamento e buy-in in ogni fase. Project & Stakeholder Management - Guidare la chiarezza nei flussi di lavoro strutturando le linee temporali, identificare i punti di decisione e anticipare i rischi. - Seguire con gli stakeholder per garantire il progresso e l'allineamento. - Elevare i problemi presto e proporre scenari di mitigazione. Il tuo viaggio finora - 5-8 anni di strategia, innovazione, business design, consulenza o gestione strategica del progetto. - L'esperienza in ospitalità, crociera, vendita al dettaglio, beni di consumo, o l'esperienza degli ospiti è un vantaggio forte. - Forte sfondo nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di esperienze orientate agli ospiti, dal concetto alla consegna. - Un equilibrio di creatività e know-how operativo, in grado di sognare grande e consegnare praticamente. - Provato track record nella gestione di team complessi e interfunzionali (operazioni, creativo, marketing, vendite, ricavi, comunicazioni), con la capacità di unire prospettive diverse intorno a una singola visione. - Ottima conoscenza dei moderni strumenti di comunicazione visiva (Canva, Adobe Suite, piattaforme creative basate su AI) per produrre documenti visivi e attività di storytelling oltre i tradizionali ponti di scorrimento. - Eccellente capacità di costruzione di relazioni; in grado di ispirare, influenzare e connettersi tra diverse squadre. - Forte capacità di narrazione e presentazione, con fiducia a livello esecutivo. - Capacità di viaggiare 20-30% del tempo. - Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive a plus. I tuoi essenziali - Proficienza in Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook. - EU Passport o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

descriptionByLocale.de: Dein Zweck Können Sie Komplexität in Klarheit verwandeln? Werden Sie durch die Gestaltung von Ideen, die Herausforderung von Annahmen und die Verstärkung der Wirkung eines Führers angetrieben? Wir suchen einen New Builds Development & Delivery Manager, der als Erweiterung des Senior Manager of Concept Innovation fungiert, das strategische Denken verbessert, die Entscheidungsgeschwindigkeit verbessert und dazu beiträgt, robuste, qualitativ hochwertige Konzepte in die Geschäftsleitung zu bringen. Diese rolle ist nicht operativ und keine präsentationsaktualisierungsposition. Es ist eine Partnerschaftsrolle, die für jemanden gedacht ist, der kritisch denken, mehrdeutige Probleme strukturieren, Insights herausfordern und die Entwicklung transformierender Gästeerlebniskonzepte unterstützen kann. Sie arbeiten eng mit Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild und Strategie zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Konzepte analytisch fundiert, aufschlussreich und auf die Erwartungen des Unternehmens ausgerichtet sind. Sie werden sich strategischen Diskussionen aussetzen, die Entscheidungsfindung von Führungskräften beeinflussen und Klarheit über Innovations-Workstreams hinweg schaffen. Wenn Sie ein scharfer Denker, ein natürlicher Herausforderer und ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind, der in der Lage ist, die Arbeit anderer zu erhöhen, ist dies die Rolle für Sie Ihre Wirkung Strategische Unterstützung & Thought Partnerschaft - Handeln Sie als direkter strategischer Partner des Senior Managers und helfen Sie dabei, das Denken zu strukturieren, Probleme zu formulieren und Konzeptnarrative zu schärfen. - Nehmen Sie an ausgewählten Meetings teil oder leiten Sie diese im Namen von Guest Experience Innovation Bereiten Sie strategische Briefings, Entscheidungsrahmen und Synthesedokumente für Gespräche auf SVP-Ebene vor. Narrative Gebäude & Executive-Ready Kommunikation Erstellen Sie klare, prägnante und strategisch fundierte Storytelling-Materialien für Führungsforen Verwandeln Sie komplexe Informationen in wirkungsvolle Narrative. - Unterstützung der Führung bei der Vorbereitung der SVP/EVP/Exekutivausschuss-Gespräche. Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit - Engagieren Sie sich mit Experience-, Entertainment-, Retail-, Marketing-, Newbuild-, Strategie- und Operations-Teams, um Erkenntnisse zu sammeln und Konzepte zu gestalten. Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung neuer Unterhaltungskonzepte, Erlebnisse und Räume in unserer gesamten Flotte. Handeln Sie als zentrales Bindeglied zwischen kreativen Partnern, Betrieb und Unternehmensfunktionen und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung und das Buy-in in jeder Phase. Projekt- und Stakeholdermanagement - Steigern Sie Klarheit in den Workstreams, indem Sie Zeitpläne strukturieren, Entscheidungspunkte identifizieren und Risiken antizipieren. - Follow-up mit Stakeholdern, um Fortschritte und Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten. Erhöhen Sie Probleme frühzeitig und schlagen Sie Minderungsszenarien vor. Deine Reise bisher - 5-8 Jahre in Strategie, Innovation, Business Design, Beratung oder strategischem Projektmanagement. - Erfahrung in Gastfreundschaft, Kreuzfahrt, Einzelhandel, Konsumgütern oder Gästeerlebnis ist ein starkes Plus. - Starker Hintergrund bei der Gestaltung und Durchführung gastorientierter Erlebnisse, vom Konzept bis zur Lieferung. - Ein Gleichgewicht von Kreativität und operativem Know-how, in der Lage, groß zu träumen und praktisch zu liefern. - Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung komplexer, funktionsübergreifender Teams (Betrieb, Kreativität, Marketing, Vertrieb, Umsatz, Kommunikation) mit der Fähigkeit, verschiedene Perspektiven um eine einzige Vision zu vereinen. Ausgezeichnetes Wissen über moderne visuelle Kommunikationstools (Canva, Adobe Suite, KI-gesteuerte Kreativplattformen), um überzeugende visuelle Dokumente und Storytelling-Assets jenseits traditioneller Foliendecks zu erstellen. Ausgezeichnete beziehungsaufbauende fähigkeiten; in der lage, verschiedene teams zu inspirieren, zu beeinflussen und zu verbinden. Starke Storytelling- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, mit Vertrauen auf Führungsebene. - Fähigkeit, 20-30% der Zeit zu reisen. - fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Plus. Ihre Essentials - Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint und Outlook. - EU-Pass oder Recht auf Arbeit in der Schweiz. Unser Engagement Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die verschiedene Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

The Travelling Destination Manager drives the performance, consistency, and growth of the Destination Experiences operation across the fleet by supporting onboard teams, enhancing the guest experience, and ensuring alignment between commercial objectives, operational standards, and Company strategy.

Your Impact

Contribute to revenue growth, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence by coaching onboard teams, identifying improvement opportunities, implementing best practices, and ensuring the successful execution of Destination Experiences initiatives across the fleet. • Strong commercial awareness with the ability to analyze performance and identify growth opportunities.
• Experience in training, coaching, and developing multicultural teams.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Valid Passport

Il tuo impatto

Contribuisci alla crescita dei ricavi, alla soddisfazione degli ospiti e all'eccellenza operativa allenando i team di bordo, individuando opportunità di miglioramento, implementando le migliori pratiche e garantendo la riuscita dell'esecuzione delle iniziative Destination Experiences in tutta la flotta. Attraverso regolari visite delle navi, audit e recensioni delle prestazioni, guidare il miglioramento continuo e sostenere il raggiungimento degli obiettivi dipartimentali e aziendali.

• Forte consapevolezza commerciale con la capacità di analizzare le prestazioni e identificare le opportunità di crescita.
• Esperienza nella formazione, formazione e sviluppo di team multiculturali.
• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità di problem solving.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestendo più priorità in un ambiente frenetico.
• Esperienza di lavoro con KPI operativi, metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e obiettivi di reddito.
• Volontà e capacità di viaggiare ampiamente attraverso la flotta.

Passaporto valido

Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.An exciting opportunity exists for a talented Digital Professional to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys. This role is based in the office in Geneva.The Digital Platforms Manager will lead the strategy, development and deployment of our travel App.

Your Impact

The Digital platforms Manager will:

- Lead the strategy of the EJ guest Area including My Explora and our travel App

- Design and lead the development of the new App

- Define and maintain the Guest Area strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals.

- Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for platform management.

- Identify opportunities for platforms innovation, optimization, and new capabilities.

- Document product features and create user stories

- Lead the creation and maintenance of platforms roadmap

- Translate complex technical requirements into actionable product specifications

- Communicate with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and business stakeholders

- Support the testing and release processes for new product updates

- Spot, report and follow the resolution & correction of bugs

- Monitor product performance metrics and making data-driven decisions

- Define KPIs and dashboards to track platform success.

Your Journey so far

- You have minimum of 8/10 years’ experience in a similar Role preferably in the Luxury or Luxury Hospitality/Travel Industry

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Digital Marketing, or related field.

- Experience managing web platforms, mobile apps, or enterprise digital ecosystems.

Your Essentials

- You set yourself apart through your personal accountability to deliver with excellence

- You are structured, well organized and know how to navigate in a matrix organisation

- Strong knowledge on the Digital projects lifecycle, particularly on complex or highly technical products

- You are a fast learner and tech savvy

- Knowledge in Adobe Experience Manager is a plus

- Fluent in English

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.title: Junior Architect Port Development Intern
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Il Junior Architect supporta il team Port Development attraverso una produzione veloce e accurata di disegni concettuali e tecnici.
Il ruolo è focalizzato sull'esecuzione interna: trasformare gli input di progettazione in documentazione concettuale e visualizzazioni efficaci per supportare il processo decisionale in destinazioni private, terminal crociere, infrastrutture portuali e strutture correlate.

Il tuo impatto

- Sostenere la traduzione di input di business e design in studi di zoning, diagrammi spaziali di base e layout architettonici.

- Assistere nello sviluppo di layout preliminari a seguito di indicazioni di progettazione interna e requisiti operativi.

- Preparare pacchetti di progettazione concettuale di fase iniziale per la revisione interna e il coordinamento.

- Produrre ponti di presentazione, diagrammi, narrazioni visive e schede materiali per supportare la comunicazione interna.

- Sviluppare modelli 3D obbligatori e visualizzazioni in tempo reale per supportare recensioni interne e presentazioni a livello executive.

- Aggiornare rapidamente, correggere e rivedere i disegni architettonici, inclusi piani, sezioni, elevazioni, layout, studi di facciata e diagrammi di circolazione.

- Adapt e coordinare la porta e disegni civili, tra cui layout del sito, interfacce infrastrutturali, strade di circolazione e coordinamento del paesaggio duro.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Forte passione per l'architettura e il mondo degli interni, dei materiali e della composizione spaziale.

- Curioso e orientato al design, con attenzione alla proporzione, atmosfera e dettaglio.

- Esecuzione guidata e altamente operativa.

- Veloce nella produzione di disegno e revisioni.

- Dettaglio e strutturato.

- Confortevole lavoro sotto tempi stringenti in un ambiente di sviluppo dinamico.

I tuoi essenziali

- Proficienza avanzata in AutoCAD con forte velocità di redazione e precisione.

- Forte capacità di modellazione 3D in SketchUp o Revit (preferito SketchUp).

- Esperienza obbligatoria con strumenti di rendering in tempo reale (Enscape, Twinmotion o equivalente).

- Buona conoscenza di Photoshop per post-produzione e correzioni.

- Conoscenza di base di strumenti AI (o di interesse) come Diffusione Stabile o AI Magnifico.

- La capacità di produrre in modo indipendente le visualizzazioni chiare e standard per il processo decisionale interno.

- Portfolio che include disegni tecnici e visualizzazioni rese da condividere con il CV.

Il Junior Architect Port Development Intern deve essere iscritto in un programma di studio che richiede un valido accordo di stage. I candidati devono avere un passaporto UE o avere il diritto legale di lavorare in Svizzera. È richiesta una completa competenza professionale in inglese; le lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Dein Zweck

Der Junior Architect unterstützt das Port Development Team durch schnelle und genaue Erstellung von konzeptionellen und technischen Zeichnungen.
Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf die interne Ausführung: Umwandlung von Design-Inputs in konzeptionelle Dokumentation und effektive Visualisierungen, um die Entscheidungsfindung in privaten Destinationen, Kreuzfahrtterminals, Hafeninfrastruktur und verwandten Einrichtungen zu unterstützen.

Ihre Wirkung

- Unterstützung der Übersetzung von Business- und Design-Inputs in Zoning-Studien, grundlegende räumliche Diagramme und architektonische Layouts.

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von vorläufigen Layouts nach internen Design-Anleitungen und betrieblichen Anforderungen.

Bereiten Sie frühzeitig konzeptionelle Designpakete für die interne Überprüfung und Koordination vor.

Erstellen Sie Präsentationsdecks, Diagramme, visuelle Erzählungen und Materialtafeln zur Unterstützung der internen Kommunikation.

Entwickeln Sie obligatorische 3D-Modelle und Echtzeit-Visualisierungen, um interne Bewertungen und Präsentationen auf Führungsebene zu unterstützen.

- Schnelle Aktualisierung, Korrektur und Überarbeitung architektonischer Zeichnungen, einschließlich Plänen, Abschnitten, Erhebungen, Layouts, Fassadenstudien und Zirkulationsdiagrammen.

- Anpassen und Koordinieren von Hafen- und Zivilzeichnungen, einschließlich Standortlayouts, Infrastrukturschnittstellen, Umlaufstraßen und Hardscape-Koordination.

Deine Reise bisher

Starke Leidenschaft für Architektur und die Welt der Innenräume, Materialien und räumlichen Zusammensetzung.

- Neugierig und designorientiert, mit Aufmerksamkeit auf Proportion, Atmosphäre und Detail.

- Ausführungsorientiert und hochgradig operativ.

- Schnell in der Zeichnung Produktion und Revisionen.

- Detailorientiert und strukturiert.

- Komfortables Arbeiten unter engen Zeitlinien in einer dynamischen Entwicklungsumgebung.

Ihre Essentials

- Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in AutoCAD mit starker Zeichengeschwindigkeit und Präzision.

- Starke 3D-Modellierungsfunktionen in SketchUp oder Revit (SketchUp bevorzugt).

Obligatorische Erfahrung mit Echtzeit-Rendering-Tools (Enscape, Twinmotion oder gleichwertig).

- Gute Kenntnisse von Photoshop für die Postproduktion und Korrekturen.

Grundkenntnisse (oder Interesse an) KI-Tools wie Stable Diffusion oder Magnific AI.

- Die Fähigkeit, unabhängig klare Visualisierungen in Standardqualität für die interne Entscheidungsfindung zu erstellen.

- Portfolio mit technischen Zeichnungen und gerenderten Visualisierungen, die mit dem Lebenslauf geteilt werden.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Organizational Development

descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only. The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization. For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction. For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles. Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations. Your Impact Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore) - Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees. - Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore. - Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as: - guest experience excellence - safety and compliance - operational performance - leadership effectiveness - digital and business transformation - Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments. - Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions. Shore-Based Learning & Development - Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions. - Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as: - leadership effectiveness - commercial capabilities - digital transformation - operational excellence - guest-centric culture - Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders. - Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement (à bord et à terre) et de la gestion des talents (à terre) est chargé de définir et de diriger la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement à la fois pour les employés à bord et à terre, tout en surveillant la gestion des talents et la planification de la relève pour les populations à terre seulement. Ce rôle permet à l'entreprise de développer les capacités nécessaires pour offrir des expériences exceptionnelles aux clients, l'excellence opérationnelle et un leadership solide à l'échelle mondiale, y compris des milliers d'équipages de navires et une organisation à terre diversifiée. Pour les employés de bord, le rôle consiste à renforcer les capacités opérationnelles et de service de calibre mondial au moyen d'une formation structurée, d'un perfectionnement en leadership et de cadres de progression de carrière qui appuient le rendement de la flotte et la satisfaction des clients. Pour les employés à terre, le rôle est à la fois responsable de l'apprentissage et du perfectionnement et de la gestion des talents, y compris le perfectionnement du leadership, la planification de la relève et le perfectionnement des talents pour les rôles de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des dirigeants opérationnels supérieurs dans l'ensemble des opérations, de l'expérience des invités et des fonctions ministérielles, ce rôle est à l'origine d'une culture d'apprentissage continu, d'excellence en leadership et de renforcement des capacités organisationnelles dans l'ensemble des opérations mondiales de l'entreprise. Votre impact Stratégie mondiale d'apprentissage et de développement (à bord et à terre) - Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement qui couvre à la fois les équipages et les employés à terre. - Élaborer un écosystème d'apprentissage intégré qui appuie l'excellence opérationnelle à bord et la capacité de leadership à terre. - Veiller à ce que les initiatives d'apprentissage appuient directement les priorités stratégiques telles que : - excellence de l'expérience des invités - sécurité et conformité - performance opérationnelle - efficacité de la direction - transformation numérique et commerciale - Superviser les cadres d'intégration et de perfectionnement pour accélérer l'intégration et le rendement des employés à bord et à terre. - Diriger l'adoption d'approches d'apprentissage modernes, y compris l'apprentissage numérique, la formation par simulation, le microapprentissage et les solutions d'apprentissage mixte. Apprentissage et développement à terre - Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour les employés à terre dans l'ensemble des fonctions ministérielles et opérationnelles. - Élaborer des initiatives de renforcement des capacités à l'appui des principales priorités opérationnelles, notamment : - capacités commerciales - transformation numérique - excellence opérationnelle - culture centrée sur les invités - Concevoir des programmes structurés de perfectionnement en leadership à l'intention des dirigeants émergents, moyens et supérieurs. - Élaborer des académies fonctionnelles et des cadres de capacités qui appuient les disciplines organisationnelles essentielles. Gestion des talents et planification de la relève (à terre seulement) - Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie globale de gestion des talents pour les employés à terre. - Processus de tête pour : - identification des talents et examens des talents - planification de la relève pour les rôles critiques de leadership - programmes de développement à fort potentiel - développement de pipelines de leadership - Cadres d ' organisation des carrières - Établir des partenariats avec les cadres supérieurs et les partenaires d'affaires des RH afin d'assurer une relève solide pour les postes clés de leadership organisationnel et opérationnel à terre. - Intégrer les pratiques de gestion des talents dans les cadres de gestion du rendement et de perfectionnement du leadership. Développement du leadership - Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des programmes de perfectionnement en leadership à l'appui des populations de leadership à bord des navires et à terre. - Mettre en place un cadre de leadership mondial aligné sur les valeurs de l'entreprise et la culture centrée sur les clients. - Renforcer les capacités de leadership dans des domaines tels que : - leadership des personnes - prise de décisions opérationnelles - excellence des services - innovation et amélioration continue - Leadership interculturel Votre voyage jusqu'à présent Éducation - Maîtrise en ressources humaines, développement organisationnel, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe. Expérience - 15 ans et plus d'expérience progressive en apprentissage et développement, gestion des talents ou développement organisationnel. - Expérience importante de la conception et de la mise en œuvre de stratégies d'apprentissage à l'échelle mondiale pour les travailleurs internationaux de grande taille. - Expérience éprouvée des programmes de gestion des talents et de planification de la relève à l'intention des groupes de dirigeants ministériels. - Expérience en croisière, en hospitalité, en voyage, en aviation ou dans d'autres grandes organisations axées sur les services. - Expérience de travail dans des environnements très multiculturels et géographiquement répartis. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario. Il tuo scopo Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso. Parte del team di Marketing globale e riportando direttamente al Brand Director, questo ruolo svolge un ruolo centrale nella salvaguardia, nella modellazione e nell'attivazione del marchio Explora Journeys in tutti i punti di contatto, con una particolare attenzione alle campagne di marca, alla flotta e ai nuovi sviluppi del marchio. Situato nella nostra sede di Ginevra, questo ruolo si trova all'intersezione della strategia di marca, della narrazione dei prodotti e dell'esecuzione, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media e Digital per portare il marchio alla vita con chiarezza, consistenza e profondità emotiva, attraverso i mercati. Il tuo impatto Gestione e Governance dei marchi - Agire come tutore principale del marchio Explora Journeys, supportando il Brand Director nella gestione quotidiana, nello sviluppo e nell'evoluzione del marchio. - Assicurare l'applicazione coerente di identità di marca, tono di voce, messaggistica e linguaggio visivo in tutti i punti di contatto, canali e viaggi degli ospiti. - Condurre lo sviluppo, l'evoluzione e la manutenzione delle linee guida, dei framework e dei toolkit master, garantendo rilevanza, chiarezza e scalabilità a livello globale. - Monitorare l'esecuzione del marchio su mercati e partner, identificare proattivamente le incongruenze e lavorare in collaborazione con gli stakeholder per salvaguardare gli standard di lusso e ospitalità. - Contribuire a iniziative di strategia di marca, progetti di evoluzione del marchio e formazione interna del marchio, rafforzare la comprensione e l'allineamento del marchio in tutta l'organizzazione. Campagne, contenuti e attività di marca - Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di campagne di master brand e prodotti, in linea con la strategia del marchio e le priorità commerciali. - Superare la creazione di eroi e beni di prodotto, tra cui visivi chiave, quadri di copia, brochure, fotografia e videografia. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team Media, Digital e PR per garantire un'espressione coerente e premium del marchio attraverso canali pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati. - Gestire e curare i contenuti di marca, prodotto e flotta all'interno dei sistemi DAM e PIM, garantendo precisione, facilità d'uso e adozione di mercato globale. Marketing del prodotto – Fleet & Onboard Experience - Possedere e articolare la narrazione del marchio e del prodotto per la flotta Explora Journeys, traducendo il design delle navi, le esperienze a bordo e la filosofia di servizio in avvincente, chiaro, e guest-centric storytelling. - Agire come partner chiave del marchio per i team di Product, New Builds e Hotel Operations, supportando progetti in tutto il ciclo di vita della nave; dal concetto iniziale alla consegna, al lancio e all'evoluzione in-service. - Definire e attivare proposizioni e concetti a livello di nave, esperienze a bordo, concetti suite, pilastri culinari, benessere e vendita al dettaglio, e rituali di servizio. - Assicurare l'allineamento tra l'esperienza ospite a bordo e la promessa del marchio comunicata al mercato. Launch & Go to Market Coordination - Supporto del marchio e prontezza del prodotto per nuove iniziative di marca, campagne, lanci delle navi, grandi pietre miliari e innovazioni a bordo. - Sviluppare strumenti di lancio master per dotare canali, mercati, vendite e PR con chiare narrazioni, posizionamento e attività. - Assicurare coerenza, chiarezza e allineamento del marchio in tutte le comunicazioni interne ed esterne relative a marca, flotta ed evoluzione del prodotto. Collaborazione funzionale e eccellenza operativa - Agire come partner di marca di fiducia attraverso le funzioni, promuovendo l'allineamento tra brand, prodotto, commerciale e team operativi - Coordinare budget, fornitori, previsioni, ordini di acquisto e fatturazione relative alle iniziative di marca. - Equilibrare il marchio strategico pensando con le mani sull'esecuzione in un ambiente veloce. Il tuo viaggio finora - Laurea magistrale in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, o in un campo relativo. - 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione del marchio e nella costruzione di campagne. - Esperienza prioritaria all'interno di lusso, premium o high-end di viaggio, ospitalità o marchi di consumatori fortemente preferito. - Esperienza comprovata che opera in un ambiente di quartier generale globale, gestione dei quadri di marca e dei beni master in tutti i mercati. - Esperienza di agenzie di gestione e partner creativi esterni. I tuoi essenziali - Esposizione al marketing del prodotto e ai prodotti basati sull'esperienza fisica (ship, hotel, resort o ambienti premium complessi altamente desiderabili). - Forte sensibilità creativa combinata con rigore operativo, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder. - Comodo spostamento tra pensiero strategico del marchio e esecuzione dettagliata. - Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un forte vantaggio. A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia. 
• Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

Il tuo scopo

Stiamo cercando un PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager dedicato ad alto livello per supervisionare un progetto di investimento infrastrutturale strategico nei Caraibi, mentre istituisce la disciplina di governance e esecuzione attraverso progetti attuali e futuri nella pipeline di investimento.
Questo ruolo ha piena responsabilità per la consegna del progetto, la finanza, la costruzione, commerciale, operativo, le risorse umane, le normative e le dimensioni degli stakeholder. Il candidato di successo agirà come unico punto di coordinamento e controllo tra investitori, appaltatori, operatori, prestatori e parti interessate del governo.

Il tuo impatto

• Stabilire e guidare un sistema di gestione dei progetti, tra cui governance, reporting, controlli e KPI.
• Guidare l'esecuzione end-to-end di grandi progetti infrastrutturali, dallo sviluppo attraverso la costruzione e le operazioni.
• supervisiona la consegna delle costruzioni e i finanziamenti del progetto, inclusi budget, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, requisiti di credito e reporting.
• Lead commerciale e contratti di gestione, fornitore e concessione accordi PPP.
• Assicurare la disponibilità operativa e la consegna, compresi i sistemi, il personale e le procedure.
• Coordinare la pianificazione delle risorse umane e della forza lavoro, garantire il rispetto delle leggi sul lavoro locali e la gestione efficace degli appaltatori.
• Identificare e gestire i rischi di progetto attraverso dimensioni tecniche, finanziarie, regolamentari, ESG e politiche.
• Fornire supporto di supervisione e esecuzione PMO per ulteriori progetti nell'imbuto di sviluppo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• Corso di laurea in Ingegneria, Finanza, Business, o campo correlato; Laurea preferito.
• 15 anni di esperienza in infrastrutture su larga scala o progetti di asset reali.
• Dimostrata leadership di progetti complessi e ad alta intensità di capitale con più stakeholder.
• Forte esperienza nella costruzione, nella finanza di progetto, nei contratti commerciali e nelle operazioni.
• Esperienza nei mercati emergenti e/o nella regione caraibica fortemente preferita.
• PMP / PRINCE2 o certificazione equivalente preferito.

I tuoi essenziali

• Hands-on, strutturato e altamente responsabile
• Presenza e credibilità esecutivo con gli stakeholder senior
• Confortevole lavoro in ambienti complessi e multi-giurisdizionali
• Volontà di viaggiare ed essere in loco come richiesto

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Zweck

Wir suchen einen hochkarätigen, engagierten PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager, um ein strategisches Infrastrukturinvestitionsprojekt in der Karibik zu beaufsichtigen und gleichzeitig die Governance- und Ausführungsdisziplin für aktuelle und zukünftige Projekte in der Investitionspipeline zu etablieren.
Diese Rolle trägt die volle Rechenschaftspflicht für die Projektabwicklung, die sich auf die Bereiche Finanzen, Bau, Wirtschaft, Betrieb, Personal, Regulierung und Stakeholder erstreckt. Ihre Wirkung

• Einrichtung und Leitung eines Projektmanagementsystems, einschließlich Governance, Reporting, Kontrollen und KPIs.
• Die End-to-End-Ausführung großer Infrastrukturprojekte von der Entwicklung über den Bau bis hin zum Betrieb.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) :

- Right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
